cases.question: What is QairuHub?
cases.notes: Kazakhstan tech community born at QAIRU, Astana; everyone welcome at any level; team, knowledge and a stage; events, mentorship, platform, Demo Day, Accelerator.
cases.answer:
**QairuHub is a Kazakhstan tech community** born at Qazaq AI Research University (QAIRU) in Astana. Everyone is welcome, regardless of skill level.

It helps students find teams, gain practical knowledge and showcase what they build through events, hackathons, mentorship and masterclasses. Learn more in [The QairuHub Handbook](/handbook).

cases.question: How do I join?
cases.notes: Free; follow t.me/qairuhub; join form; QAIRU students sign up at community.qairuhub.com with @qairu.edu.kz, admin approval; come to events.
cases.answer:
Joining QairuHub is free:

1. Follow announcements on [Telegram](https://t.me/qairuhub).
2. Fill out the join form on this site.
3. If you’re a QAIRU student, create an account at [community.qairuhub.com](https://community.qairuhub.com/sign-up) using your `@qairu.edu.kz` email.
4. Attend an event, join a project, or publish your own.

cases.question: QairuHub-қа қалай қосылуға болады?
cases.notes: Same facts in natural Kazakh, informal сен, Latin names, hyphenated suffixes.
cases.answer:
QairuHub-қа қосылу тегін және бәріне ашық:

- Telegram арнасына жазыл: https://t.me/qairuhub
- Осы сайттағы қосылу формасын толтыр.
- QAIRU студенті болсаң, @qairu.edu.kz поштасымен https://community.qairuhub.com/sign-up тіркел.
- Іс-шараға қатысып, жобаға қосыл немесе өз идеяңды жарияла.

Бағдарламалау тәжірибесі міндетті емес — дизайн, зерттеу, медиа немесе өнім бағыттарынан бастауға болады.

cases.question: Сколько стоит участие в QairuHub?
cases.notes: Answers in Russian: free, no fees ever; the club holds no money.
cases.answer:
Участие в **QairuHub бесплатное** — членских взносов и других обязательных платежей нет. Студенты ничего не платят за мероприятия, проекты или платформу.

Следующий шаг: подпишись на [Telegram-канал QairuHub](https://t.me/qairuhub) и заполни форму на сайте.

cases.question: When does QairuHub Accelerator open and how long is it?
cases.notes: Planned for spring 2027 (founding record: May); draft 8–10 weeks, teams with a demo, mentors from week one, no equity; application dates TBA.
cases.answer:
**QairuHub Accelerator is planned**, but application dates have not been announced yet. Leave your email in the Accelerator block on this site to hear when applications open.

The current design draft is **8–10 weeks** long. Details may change.

cases.question: QairuHub Demo Day қашан өтеді?
cases.notes: Planned November 2026; date and venue to be announced; audience: students, faculty, partners, investors.
cases.answer: QairuHub Demo Day-дің алғашқысы **2026 жылғы қарашада** өтуі жоспарланған. Нақты күні мен орны әлі жарияланған жоқ. Жаңартуларды [Telegram арнасынан](https://t.me/qairuhub) тексер.

cases.question: If I build a startup through QairuHub, who owns it?
cases.notes: The team, 100%: code, rights, commercialisation; no equity, no IP claim; the club holds no money.
cases.answer: **You and your team own 100% of it**—including the code, rights and commercialisation. QairuHub takes no equity and makes no IP claim.

cases.question: I have an idea but no team. What should I do?
cases.notes: Publish on community.qairuhub.com, open roles with skill/hours/deadline, Team Finder, come to events and mentorship.
cases.answer:
Publish your idea on [community.qairuhub.com](https://community.qairuhub.com), even if it’s rough. Open roles describing the skills, hours per week, and deadline you need; students can find it through Team Finder.

You can also share the project at a QairuHub event and ask mentors or peers for help. The project and its rights remain 100% yours.

cases.question: I study at Nazarbayev University. Can I join?
cases.notes: Events and Telegram are open to everyone; platform needs @qairu.edu.kz for now; other universities not decided; point to the form or channel.
cases.answer:
**You can attend QairuHub events and join the Telegram channel.** The community platform currently requires a QAIRU email ending in `@qairu.edu.kz`, and access for students from other universities has not been decided yet.

Join the updates here: https://t.me/qairuhub

cases.question: Is Cursor or Lovable a QairuHub partner?

cases.answer: No. **Cursor and Lovable are tools used by QairuHub builders, not formal partners.** The same applies to Qaldy AI and other listed tools.

cases.question: Who runs QairuHub?
cases.notes: Five-seat executive board with names and roles; seats rotate by vote; nobody owns it; link /members.
cases.answer:
QairuHub is run day to day by its elected five-seat executive board:

- Tair Kaldybayev — President
- Mustafa Kassym — CTO
- Alikhan Altayev — Finance & Partnerships Leader
- Tamerlan Shaigali — Media & Socials Leader
- Nazar Akanov — Community & Events Leader

They work with active members who lead projects such as the platform, bots and media.

cases.question: Жобамды сайтта қалай көрсетуге болады?
cases.notes: Publish on the platform, keep status real, show a demo, tell the team through the form; student projects are featured too.
cases.answer:
Жобаңызды сайтта көрсету үшін:

- Оны [community.qairuhub.com](https://community.qairuhub.com) сайтында жариялаңыз: қысқа сипаттама, нақты статус және мүмкін болса ашық репозиторий қосыңыз.
- Статусын жаңартып отырыңыз: Recruiting, In progress немесе Demo shown.
- Жобаны QairuHub демо-сессиясында немесе QairuHub Demo Day-де көрсетіңіз.
- Сайттағы join form арқылы **“I have a project”** таңдаңыз немесе Telegram-дағы талқылау чатына жазыңыз.

Жобаларды QairuHub медиа командасы таңдайды; көрсету автоматты түрде кепілденбейді.

cases.question: I signed up on community.qairuhub.com but can't get in. Why?
cases.notes: Sign-up needs @qairu.edu.kz and admin approval; for access issues contact VP / Operations via t.me/qairuhub.
cases.answer:
Your account needs approval first—an administrator reviews every application before access opens. Also check that you signed up with a university email ending in **@qairu.edu.kz**.

If you don’t have that email yet, contact QAIRU IT. For other issues, follow updates at [t.me/qairuhub](https://t.me/qairuhub).

cases.question: Does QairuHub invest in student startups or give grants?
cases.notes: No: the club holds no money, takes no equity and doesn't handle investment; Demo Day (planned) is meant to include investors, invitations TBA; Accelerator takes no equity.
cases.answer:
No. **QairuHub doesn’t invest in startups or give grants**—it holds no money, takes no equity, and doesn’t handle investment funds. Any investment goes directly to the team.

QairuHub Accelerator is **planned** with no equity or IP claim. For updates, follow [Telegram](https://t.me/qairuhub).
